description: This Java source file defines the CacheFactory class, a utility class responsible for creating and configuring caches and related objects based on specified configurations. It provides methods to create caches with or without loaders, generate cache keys, and establish cache lookup contexts. The class leverages the Caffeine caching library and ensures thread-safe cache creation.
